system.history:
An owner, clerk, vendor, or neighborhood merchant who knows local customers, deliveries, and daily routines.

Scene use: Witness, information broker, victim of property damage, neighborhood contact, or keeper of useful security footage.
system.personality: Observant, protective of the business, and quick to recognize unusual behavior. Decide whether hospitality or suspicion comes first.
system.distinguishingFeatures: Apron or store badge, keys, handheld terminal, and easy access to counters and stock rooms.

system.description: A close defensive strike with an object kept behind the counter.
